status.en: 77 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 40% more than the week before, most of them in Sanaa, Mokha and Marib.
status.nb: 77 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 40 prosent flere enn uken før, flest i Sanaa, Mokha og Marib.

summary.en: Houthis launched missile strikes on Riyadh airport that killed twelve people, including an airline captain, and wounded hundreds, prompting the airport’s closure and Saudi vows of a major response. The Houthis also threatened Saudi airspace and warned they could target other Saudi airports. Yemeni government forces reported advancing against the Houthis as fighting spread to Yemen’s capital and other cities. The EU condemned the Riyadh airport attack as part of Iran‑backed proxy aggression. The conflict caused 918 battle‑related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Houthis skjøt missiler mot Riyadh flyplass som drepte tolv personer, inkludert en flykaptein, og såret hundrevis, noe som førte til at flyplassen ble stengt og Saudi-Arabia lovet en stor respons. Houthis truet også saudisk luftrom og advarte om at de kunne angripe andre saudiske flyplasser. Jemens regjeringstyrker rapporterte at de rykket frem mot Houthis etter hvert som kampene spredte seg til Jemens hovedstad og andre byer. EU fordømte angrepet på Riyadh flyplass som en del av Iran‑støttet proxy‑aggressjon. Konflikten forårsaket 918 dødsfall i kamprelaterte handlinger i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Yemeni civil war (2014–present)
background.extract: The Yemeni civil war is an ongoing multilateral civil war that began in late 2014 mainly between the Rashad al-Alimi-led Presidential Leadership Council and the Mahdi al-Mashat-led Supreme Political Council, along with their respective supporters and allies. Both sides claim to constitute the official government of Yemen while the Presidential Leadership Council is recognized by the United Nations as the official government.
